en: A black-and-white aerial photograph of a small village or settlement surrounded by forest. A church with a tall steeple is visible near the center right, along with residential buildings and what appears to be a more industrial or school-like structure in the upper left. The postcard has some printed Swedish text on it, including a caption describing a flyfoto (aerial photo) of Anundgård, and there is a photo credit in the margin.
